Task, settings and judge prompt

Each model has 256 samples per requested parity × grader condition. Conflicting graders reward the opposite parity; matching graders reward the requested parity. “Cheated” means the final answer has the opposite parity to the request.

Temperature 1 · top-p 0.95 · 16,384 output-token cap. Base served by Groq; organisms by Tinker. Provider differences remain a confound. Judge: Google AI Studio through OpenRouter, temperature 0, low effort; sees the request with grader metadata and the CoT, without the final answer.
